verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's Entity Manager automatically displays registrations, statuses, and key data, and offers a per-entity interactive map of state registrations. Its docs also describe identifying registrations across states, monitoring entity statuses, and seeing due dates and filing status. missing for 10: explicit evidence that standing and upcoming deadlines appear together in one unified dashboard (due dates are described on the annual-report page rather than in Entity Manager), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
